## Summary

I added a `currency` setting to the `Config` class with a default value of `"USD"`. The change was minimal—just one line added to the dataclass definition:

```python
currency: str = "USD"
```

**Why this approach:**
- It follows the exact same pattern as the existing settings (`db_path`, `rates_url`)
- The `load()` function automatically handles it—it filters TOML data to only known field names, so the new field is immediately configurable
- Users can now set `currency = "EUR"` (or any other value) in their `ledger.toml` file
- The default "USD" is used if not specified in the config file
- All existing tests continue to pass
